changeSet.author: lifefit-architecture
changeSet.comment: Ticket: LF-0040. A membership can be assigned without a branch. Branch remains available for check-in and for filtering. Index review: FK_GymMemberships_Branches stays; no list index leads with BranchId, and IX_GymMemberships_TenantId_Status_EndDate plus IX_GymMemberships_MemberProfileId still serve membership lists. Performance note: null branch values stay in those indexes and are skipped by an equality filter on BranchId.
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE app.GymMemberships ALTER COLUMN BranchId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NULL;

rollback.sql: ALTER TABLE app.GymMemberships ALTER COLUMN BranchId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NOT NULL;
